headline: 5 killed by lorry in Sitakunda, Chittagong; 4 more injured in tragic accident
summary: Five people died and four others were injured after a speeding lorry ran over them in Sitakunda, Chittagong. The tragic incident occurred at Kumira Royal Gate area around 1 AM on Tuesday night.
details: Five people were killed and four others injured in a tragic road accident in Sitakunda, Chittagong. The incident occurred when a speeding lorry ran over a group of passengers standing by the road.
The accident took place around 1 AM on Tuesday night at the Kumira Royal Gate area of the upazila. Police are working to identify all the victims involved in this devastating incident.

Among the deceased, a 6-year-old child named Ibrahim from Netrokona and a woman named Swapna have been identified. Authorities are continuing efforts to ascertain the identities of the remaining four victims.

According to police, the passengers were traveling from Chittagong to Netrokona by bus. Their journey was interrupted when the bus developed a fault in Kumira, prompting them to alight and stand by the roadside.
It was at this point that a fast-moving lorry lost control and struck the group. Three individuals died on the spot, while two more succumbed to their injuries after being rushed to the hospital.
The four injured individuals were rescued and admitted to Chittagong Medical College Hospital for treatment. Investigations into the exact cause of the accident are ongoing.

Among the deceased, a 6-year-old child named Ibrahim from Netrokona and a woman named Swapna have been identified. Authorities are continuing efforts to ascertain the identities of the remaining four victims.

According to police, the passengers were traveling from Chittagong to Netrokona by bus. Their journey was interrupted when the bus developed a fault in Kumira, prompting them to alight and stand by the roadside.

It was at this point that a fast-moving lorry lost control and struck the group. Three individuals died on the spot, while two more succumbed to their injuries after being rushed to the hospital.

The four injured individuals were rescued and admitted to Chittagong Medical College Hospital for treatment. Investigations into the exact cause of the accident are ongoing.

headline_marked: [[Harry Kane becomes England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years]], beating Mbappe
headline: Harry Kane becomes England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years, beating Mbappe
summary: The 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward scored a remarkable 73 goals in 65 games last season. Spain's Alexia Putellas also claimed her third women's Ballon d'Or award.
details: Harry Kane has made history, becoming England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years. He secured the prestigious Ballon d'Or award in London on Monday, overcoming strong competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

Alexia Putellas of Spain claimed the women's prize for an unprecedented third time. Her instrumental role in leading Barcelona to last season's Champions League, before her move to London City Lionesses, was key to her victory.

The 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward had an outstanding season, netting a remarkable 73 goals in 65 games for both club and country. This prolific scoring helped propel the German giants to a league and cup double.

Kane also contributed six goals as England secured a third-place finish at the World Cup. He expressed gratitude to his Bayern Munich teammates, stating their push and competition made his achievement possible.

Despite a limited medal collection since joining Bayern in 2023, Kane's consistent goalscoring has earned him football's highest individual honour. His move to Bayern, initially seen as a risk, proved to be a catalyst for his improvement.

Putellas's third Ballon d'Or marks a triumphant return to the top of women's football, four years after an anterior cruciate ligament injury. She succeeds her Spain teammate Aitana Bonmati, who was sidelined for much of last season.

Other notable awards included Lamine Yamal winning young talent of the year for the third consecutive time. Luis de la Fuente was named men's coach of the year for leading Spain to World Cup glory, and Barcelona's Pere Romeu won women's coach of the year.

Arsenal's Bukayo Saka received the Socrates award for his humanitarian work. Paris Saint-Germain was named men's club of the year, while Unai Simon and Cata Coll were recognized as best men's and women's goalkeepers, respectively.
